observation: All 10 environment failures follow accepted Cake IR submissions. Replaying all 367 retained submissions on main 030d9167 identifies 16 generated-kernel projection refusals on the faulting turns: 13 exact fma.rn.f32 inline-assembly templates and 3 float("-inf") reduction identities. The other 281 project, 45 fail parsing/lowering, and 25 are refused by assessment. The emitter already implements both primitives; the common closed source admission omitted them. These are Compiler handoff defects, not evidence of unsupported operator semantics or slow kernels.
proposed_change: Admit only the emitter exact FP32 FMA instruction, constraints, three explicit arguments, dtype, purity and pack on sm100a/sm103a; admit only direct constant float("inf") / float("-inf") with reserved binding and no callable escape. Keep arbitrary assembly, dynamic Python conversion, other targets and existing invalid candidates refused. Preserve generated kernel bodies and all numerical contracts.

verified_by.limits: Source-admission defect replay-closed. No GPU correctness/performance claim, no Lab/provider fix, no retroactive change to original terminal outcomes.

verification_plan: Successor Compiler full Corpus Gate, independent review, public frontend/lower/project positive and hostile-negative tests, and replay all 367 original submissions. Exactly the 16 owning projection failures must change; all prior refusal categories remain. Offline isolated SDK compilation is a separate bounded check, not GPU qualification.
promotion_disposition: Compiler source-admission repair; no optimization pass. Original run endpoints remain faults. Unobserved top-k/atomic/other-asm source gaps stay deferred; no generic exception suppression.
